decision_spec.purpose: Choose the first source retrieval action for the coding task.
decision_spec.success_criterion: The bounded retrieval result contains the declared target source context, checked independently of the policy.

calibration.note: Threshold search uses calibration only; confidence bounds here are descriptive after search.

promotion.decision_metric_note: Agreement with fastest safe observed choice is diagnostic only; rows with no successful action are excluded from label metrics but retained in all outcome comparisons. This is not task success or a population calibration guarantee.

test.decision_metric_note: Agreement with fastest safe observed choice is diagnostic only; rows with no successful action are excluded from label metrics but retained in all outcome comparisons. This is not task success or a population calibration guarantee.

reasons: calibration has insufficient safe delegation evidence
promotion uncertainty unavailable with fewer than two repository groups
promotion has no reliable net time improvement including startup
candidate task outcomes regress against the deterministic heuristic
locked test does not confirm outcome and time benefit
report.scope: Bounded source retrieval outcomes, not autonomous agent task success.
report.execution_contract: Cold CLI: measured startup charged on every decision; warm throughput is diagnostic only.
report.statistics: Repository-group paired bootstrap 1000 resamples; intervals unavailable below two actual repositories. Per-task Wilson bounds are descriptive under shared task grammar, not a population reliability guarantee.
report.cost_note: Retrospective action outcomes plus measured model startup and integrity screening charged per CLI request; not direct timing of every full CLI process.
